settings.brief: A modest rectangular three-storey six-flat walk-up: brick lower storey, cream upper render, shallow flat parapet roof, ONE shared central front entrance, two small balconies per floor (six total) with plain metal rails, fixed rear/end window grids, one rear service door. No tower, lifts in glass shafts, luxury roof terraces or giant glazing. Dwelling count is an art/design proposal, never game population balance.
settings.identity_policy: All doors/windows/balconies/roof panels belong to one fixed world; never substitute front geometry on rear or move panels to the camera-facing roof.
